impl: matmul (patchify): HF processor flattens 16x16x3 patches on host, board runs _projection_core M=2520 K=768 N=768 IF4
notes: HF Gemma4 patch embedder is nn.Linear(3*16*16=768, 768, bias=False) on pre-patchified pixels (== conv2d k16 s16). Image resized to 896x896 (VISION_CANONICAL_SIZE), then the processor (max_soft_tokens=280, pool k=3) resizes to 48x48 valid patches = 768x768 px; GEMM M=VISION_FIXED_NUM_PATCHES=2520 rows incl. 216 padding patches. Followed by 3x3/s3 avg-pool done as matmul with a fixed 0/1 pooling matrix (not a learned conv, not recorded). Default --frames 1.

impl: im2col on FPGA (3 strided DMA row gathers + matmul vs 0/1 selection matrix G_s0) then matmat_mul_core M=N0_pad K=64(9 real) N=128 IF4
notes: apex.wav is 5.102 s stereo 48 kHz -> mono, linear-resampled to 16 kHz = 81626 samples, padded to multiple of 128 = 81664, +160 semicausal left pad, 20 ms frame / 10 ms hop -> T_raw=510 mel frames x 128 mels (computed from HF Gemma4AudioFeatureExtractor + repo _load_audio_samples, not measured). in_h=time, in_w=mel. Output 255x64 (N0=16320 rows). Followed by LayerNorm+ReLU.

impl: eltwise depthwise T=1: 4 eltwise_mul + 3 eltwise_add on URAM + DRAM state-ring roll (decoder replay per prompt token)
notes: Qwen3.5 GatedDeltaNet causal depthwise conv1d over the fused in_proj_qkv output (conv_dim=2*key_dim+value_dim=6144, kernel 4, bias=False, BF16 weights) in each of the 18 linear-attention layers (idx%4!=3). The repo has NO T>1 conv on the default path: prefill_via_decode replays the one-shot T=1 decoder binary once per prompt token, so prefill and decode both run the T=1 step: 4 x (memcpy slot -> URAM, eltwise_mul by weight row) + 3 eltwise_add, then roll the 3-slot state ring in DRAM. pw=3 is the causal left context, supplied by the persistent state ring (previous tokens; zeros only for t<3), right pad 0; in_w=1 new token per step. (run_causal_conv1d_4tap at qwen3.5_2b_test.py:2946 is a T>1 shifted-eltwise path only used by the non-default per-layer one_shot=False route.) count = 18 layers x ~25 prompt tokens. Default prompt 'Tell me about the Eiffel Tower. What year was it built?' in the Qwen chat template = 23 tokens with a Qwen2.5 tokenizer (+~2 for an assumed '<think>\n' generation prefix); Qwen3.5 tokenizer not on disk, so 25 is an estimate.

impl: eltwise depthwise T=1: 4 eltwise_mul + 3 eltwise_add on URAM + DRAM state-ring roll (one-shot decoder, one trigger per token)
notes: Qwen3.5 GatedDeltaNet causal depthwise conv1d over the fused in_proj_qkv output (conv_dim=2*key_dim+value_dim=6144, kernel 4, bias=False, BF16 weights) in each of the 18 linear-attention layers (idx%4!=3). The repo has NO T>1 conv on the default path: prefill_via_decode replays the one-shot T=1 decoder binary once per prompt token, so prefill and decode both run the T=1 step: 4 x (memcpy slot -> URAM, eltwise_mul by weight row) + 3 eltwise_add, then roll the 3-slot state ring in DRAM. pw=3 is the causal left context, supplied by the persistent state ring (previous tokens; zeros only for t<3), right pad 0; in_w=1 new token per step. (run_causal_conv1d_4tap at qwen3.5_2b_test.py:2946 is a T>1 shifted-eltwise path only used by the non-default per-layer one_shot=False route.) count = 18 layers x 127 decode steps (default --max-new-tokens 128; the first token comes from the prefill pass; upper bound, assumes no early EOT). Shape is identical to the prefill record.

impl: matmul (patchify): HF processor flattens patches on host, board runs matmat_mul_core M=576 K=1536 N=1024 BF16 weights + broadcast bias
notes: Qwen3-VL-style Conv3d patch embed: temporal kernel 2 / stride 2 over the still image duplicated to T=2 frames (1 temporal output), spatial 16x16/16. K_PIXEL=1536=3*2*16*16. yosemite.jpg is 384x384 -> 24x24=576 patches (N_P=576, 144 merged tokens after 2x2 merger). Not executed in the default LM-only run (the encoder is only captured into programs.bin there). --no-fpga-vision runs the same conv in HF torch on host instead. Weights: pe_w uploaded BF16 (is_B_quantized=False).
Default CLI (no --image) is LM-only (Qwen2.5 text decoder: linears/norms/attention); no conv executes. The vision patch-embed conv is recorded under config '--image'.

impl: torch nn.Conv3d on host (HF visual.patch_embed, bf16) on processor-flattened patches
notes: Conv3d weight [1280,3,2,14,14] BF16, no bias (safetensors header). Temporal kernel 2 / stride 2 over the still image duplicated to T=2 (1 temporal output). Image resized to 336x336 -> 24x24=576 patches (num_patches=576, 144 merged tokens). Runs on HOST in torch bf16 (not fp32) because K=3*2*14*14=1176 is not a multiple of the 64-element IF4 block; an IF4 copy of the weight is still DMA'd to DRAM but unused. As a GEMM: M=576 K=1176 N=1280.

impl: matmul (patchify): smart_bf16_permute_core on FPGA reshapes [3,32,16,32,16]->[1024,768] patches, then matmat_mul_core M=1024 K=768 N=768 BF16 + broadcast bias
notes: Default mode is VLM (--lm-enable for text-only). vette.jpg (384x384) resized bilinear to 512x512 single image (no tiling) -> 32x32=1024 patches -> 64 image tokens after pixel-shuffle(4) connector (not a conv). Weight [768,3,16,16] F32 in checkpoint, stored to DRAM as BF16. Default --engines 2 uses compile_encoder_sharded; the patch embed runs on the primary engine only (same op at :797 in the single-engine compile_encoder). LM (SmolLM2 360M-class) has no convs.

impl: torch nn.Conv2d on host CPU (bf16) over pre-patchified [256,3,14,14] input; result + interpolated pos-emb DMA'd to board
notes: MoonViT-SO-400M PatchEmbed (locateanything_3b_cpu_test.py:113, nn.Conv2d default bias=True; HF weights not on disk so bias inferred from the module definition). vette.jpg 384x384 letterboxed to 224x224 (--square 224 default), patchified by la.ImageProcessor into 16x16=256 patches of 3x14x14, so torch actually runs the conv as batch 256 of 14x14 -> 1x1 (equivalent to one 224x224 k14 s14 conv; GEMM M=256 K=588 N=1152). 64 merged image tokens after 2x2 merge. Weights loaded in bfloat16 on host (not fp32). The --check-vision CPU reference (off by default) would run it a second time. Rest of MoonViT, connector and Qwen2.5-3B LM run on the board with no convs. The Qwen2.5-VL-style Conv3d patch_embed code in Qwen25VL3B_UnifiedEngine (:1455) is not used by main().

config: default (sample LIBERO obs: base + wrist + all-zero 3rd camera)
impl: matmul (patchify): host _patchify -> [256,588] zero-padded to K=640, board quantized matmat_mul_core M=256 K=640 N=1152 IF4 + bias
notes: One run_inference per default run. 3 image slots (pi05_libero_base.png, pi05_libero_wrist.png 256x256, bilinear-resized to 224x224, plus an all-zero pad image); SKIP_ZERO_VISION_SLOTS=False so the zero slot is still encoded -> count 3 (2 if --skip-zero-vision-slots). 16x16=256 patches per slot. Kernel [588,1152] K padded 588->640 for the IF4 64-block. PaliGemma Gemma-2B prefix LM and action expert (10 Euler denoise steps) have no convs.

config: default (variant pulsevla, --stage all, --quant bf16, synthetic 2x512x512 cameras)
impl: matmul (patchify): host _host_patchify [3,512,512]->[1024,768] channel-major, board shard_mm (matmat_mul_core) M=1024 K=768 N=768 BF16 + bias
notes: SmolVLA/PulseVLA SigLIP tower (12x768, 512px, patch 16) -> 32x32=1024 patches per camera; encoder compiled once and executed once per camera slot, num_image_slots=2 (agentview + wrist) -> count 2 per inference. Identical for all variants (smolvla, smolvla_qg, smolvla_lid, smolvla_lid_qg configs all 2 slots, same tower; sept3_tanh weights same shape). No sample obs shipped: default uses deterministic synthetic uint8 512x512 images (LIBERO eval feeds 256x256 frames resize_with_pad'ed to 512x512). The device used to patchify with smart_bf16_permute_core but that path was moved to host (comment at :3403). The bundled smolvla/components/vision.py nn.Conv2d(3,768,16,16) is the torch reference only (--snr / --stage ref / libero_eval CPU path), not run by default. Pixel-shuffle connector, SmolLM2 prefix and action expert have no convs.
